# Draft:John Stewardson Memorial Fellowship in Architecture

The John Stewardson Memorial Fellowship in Architecture (The Stewardson) is an annual $10,000 travel fellowship awarded to the winner of a 10-day individual design competition between the accredited Schools of Architecture in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. It was established in 1898 in memory of the Philadelphia Architect John Stewardson. The participating institutions include Carnegie Mellon University, Drexel University, Jefferson University, Marywood University, Penn State University, Temple University, and the University of Pennsylvania.
